claim_boundary: This theorem covers standard generalized-zero data plus the smooth Wiener-Bohr k=0 minus sector. Genuinely oscillatory nonminus carriers, maximal Sobolev domains, infinite secular inverses, nonzero momentum, causal, residual and quantum claims remain open.

SMOOTH_INFINITE_SECULAR.reason: no uniform inverse estimate is certified for the countable secular sum

interpretation: No standard homogeneous, charge, Wilson or twist datum rescues the exceptional ellipse once the bounded polynomial and resonant ledgers are imposed. The only remaining possible k=0 rescue must use genuinely oscillatory nonminus carriers whose quadratic products can screen a minus shell.
next_gate: classify genuinely oscillatory Einstein-plus, extra-primary, physical-dipole or additional exceptional carriers on the d-times-minus resonant shells

scope.boundaries: closed S1_L times S2; bounded smooth uniformly almost-periodic correction
scope.carrier: any axisymmetric exceptional resonance-ellipse point, arbitrary standard generalized-zero data, and a smooth Wiener-Bohr k=0 Einstein-minus sum
scope.charge_sector: fixed N=2 magnetic bundle with first-order electric tangent allowed
scope.ell: global ell=0,1; exceptional/control ell=1,2; every minus ell>=2 with countable support
scope.m: all global components and minus m with convergent stabilizer moment maps
scope.omega: generalized zero, exceptional/control frequencies, and occupied omega_minus(ell)
scope.parity: homogeneous plus both axial/polar dressing parities

standard_global_reduction.balance_consequence: the strictly negative ellipse plus the nonpositive surviving global contribution still requires at least one opposite-sign Einstein-minus coefficient
standard_global_reduction.completion_extension: products of bounded uniformly almost-periodic oscillators are bounded uniformly almost periodic and have no positive-degree time-polynomial coefficient, so the finite-support universal polynomial ideal remains necessary on the declared Wiener-Bohr completion
standard_global_reduction.coordinates: homogeneous (a,b,c,d,Q_e,W_x) and twist (A,B), with d the total ellipse circumference-velocity coordinate
standard_global_reduction.remaining_global_mu_H: -a^2-Q_e^2; c,d,W_x,A have zero diagonal Hamiltonian moment map

spectators.A: the fixed-ell flat-connection theorem gives zero same-shell adjoint projection and bounded neighboring-channel inverses on every generic minus block
spectators.Q_e: duality supplies a bounded mixed primitive for every oscillator
spectators.W_x: its mixed source with every oscillator vanishes
spectators.c: the exact radius-family derivative supplies a bounded mixed primitive at k=0

triangular_resonant_reduction.contradiction: moment-map balance requires a nonzero minus coefficient, while bounded compatibility removes all of them
triangular_resonant_reduction.first_step: after b=0, the nonzero a-times-minus highest time-degree pivot forces a=0 on every occupied minus block
triangular_resonant_reduction.no_global_screening: Q_e,c,W_x,A have zero resonant adjoint component by their exact transport theorems; B and b already vanish
triangular_resonant_reduction.projection_class: continuous Bohr-frequency, spherical-harmonic and target-adjoint projections from the Wiener theorem
triangular_resonant_reduction.second_step: after a=b=0, the nonzero d-times-minus pivot forces every occupied minus coefficient to vanish because d!=0
